start.description:
Year, month or date employment started.
Year must be formatted as [ISO date-fullyear](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339.html#section-5.6), the 4 digit year the course was completed, e.g. 2017
Month must be formatted as [ISO date-fullyear](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339.html#section-5.6) "-" [ISO date-month](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339.html#section-5.6), e.g. 2017-07
Date must be formatted as [ISO full-date](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339.html#section-5.6), e.g. 2017-07-31

end.description:
Year, month or date employment finished, or "Present" for a current role.
Year must be formatted as [ISO date-fullyear](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339.html#section-5.6), the 4 digit year the course was completed, e.g. 2017
Month must be formatted as [ISO date-fullyear](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339.html#section-5.6) "-" [ISO date-month](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339.html#section-5.6), e.g. 2017-07
Date must be formatted as [ISO full-date](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339.html#section-5.6), e.g. 2017-07-31
